Average and Statistics Calculator

An average and statistics calculator computes key measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and dispersion (sample and population standard deviation, variance, range) from a set of numbers. It provides full descriptive statistical analysis for researchers, students, and analysts.

Formula and Calculation Method

Descriptive statistics formulas for dataset {x₁, x₂, ..., x_n}:

Mean (x̄) = (Σ x_i) ÷ n
Median = Middle value of sorted data (or average of two middle values if n is even)
Sample Variance (s²) = [Σ (x_i - x̄)²] ÷ (n - 1)
Sample Standard Deviation (s) = √s²
Population Standard Deviation (σ) = √[Σ (x_i - μ)² ÷ N]

Worked Example and Step-by-Step Calculation

Statistics for Dataset: 12, 15, 18, 18, 22, 25, 30 (n = 7)
Input Values:
  • Dataset: 12, 15, 18, 18, 22, 25, 30

1. Count (n) = 7

2. Sum = 12 + 15 + 18 + 18 + 22 + 25 + 30 = 140

3. Mean = 140 ÷ 7 = 20.0

4. Median (4th sorted value) = 18.0

5. Mode (most frequent) = 18.0 (appears twice)

6. Range = Max - Min = 30 - 12 = 18.0

7. Sum of squared differences = (12-20)² + (15-20)² + 2(18-20)² + (22-20)² + (25-20)² + (30-20)² = 64 + 25 + 8 + 4 + 25 + 100 = 226

8. Sample Variance (s²) = 226 ÷ (7 - 1) = 37.67

9. Sample Standard Deviation (s) = √37.67 = 6.14

Result: Mean: 20.0 | Median: 18.0 | Mode: 18.0 | Sample Std Dev: 6.14

How to Use the Average and Statistics Calculator

  1. Paste or type numbers separated by commas, spaces, or line breaks.
  2. Select whether your data represents a Sample (n-1 degrees of freedom) or an entire Population (N).
  3. Instantly view the statistical summary card with mean, median, mode, and standard deviation.
  4. Review the step-by-step deviations and variance table.

Common Mistakes, Limitations & Practical Guidance

  • Extreme outliers can distort the mean; always examine the median for skewed datasets (such as real estate prices or household income).
  • Datasets with no repeated numbers have no mode, while datasets with multiple peaks are multimodal.

Frequently Asked Questions About Average and Statistics Calculator

What is the difference between sample and population standard deviation?

Use sample standard deviation (dividing by n - 1, known as Bessel's correction) when your data is a subset or sample of a larger group. Use population standard deviation (dividing by N) only when your dataset contains every single member of the entire group being studied.

When should I use median instead of mean?

Use the median when your data is skewed or contains extreme outliers (such as salaries, housing costs, or net worth), because the median reflects the true middle value and is not skewed by single massive numbers.

What does standard deviation measure?

Standard deviation measures the average dispersion or spread of data points around their mean. A small standard deviation indicates numbers are tightly clustered near the average; a large standard deviation indicates wide variability.

Can a dataset have more than one mode?

Yes. A dataset with two values tying for the highest frequency is bimodal; with three, it is trimodal; with more, it is multimodal. If all numbers occur with equal frequency, the dataset has no mode.

How does this tool connect to Probability and Data?
